workflow.name: adding-feature
workflow.displayName: Adding Feature Workflow - 添加新语言特性
workflow.objective: 在仓颉编译器中添加新的语言特性，涵盖从语法设计到代码生成的完整流程
prerequisites: 编译器已成功构建（参见 building workflow）
了解编译器的基本流程和架构
理解编译原理（词法分析、语法分析、语义分析、代码生成）
了解 LLVM IR 基础知识

steps.name: 设计语法
steps.description: Define the syntax rules for the new language feature
tasks: 确定语法结构和关键字
编写语法规范文档
考虑与现有语法的兼容性
设计示例代码展示新特性用法

steps.name: 修改 Lex
steps.description: If new tokens are needed, add them to the lexer
tasks: 在 Tokens.inc 中添加新的 token 定义
更新 token 类型枚举
添加关键字识别逻辑（如果需要）
更新词法分析器测试

steps.name: 修改 Parse
steps.description: Add new parsing rules to generate AST nodes
tasks: 在 Parser 中添加新的解析函数
实现语法规则的递归下降解析
处理语法错误和恢复
生成对应的 AST 节点
添加解析器测试

steps.name: 修改 AST
steps.description: If new node types are needed, define them in the AST
tasks: 在 Node.h 中定义新的 AST 节点类
实现节点的构造函数和访问方法
添加节点的序列化和反序列化支持
实现 AST 打印功能（用于调试）
更新 AST visitor 模式

steps.name: 修改 Sema
steps.description: Add semantic analysis and type inference rules
tasks: 实现语义检查逻辑
添加类型推断和类型检查
处理作用域和符号解析
添加语义错误诊断
实现类型转换规则（如果需要）
添加语义分析测试

steps.name: 修改 CHIR
steps.description: Add AST to CHIR (Cangjie High-level IR) transformation
tasks: 实现 AST 节点到 CHIR 的转换
添加新的 CHIR 指令或操作（如果需要）
实现 CHIR 优化（如果适用）
添加 CHIR dump 功能用于调试
添加 CHIR 转换测试

steps.name: 修改 CodeGen
steps.description: Add CHIR to LLVM IR code generation
tasks: 实现 CHIR 到 LLVM IR 的转换
生成正确的 LLVM IR 指令序列
处理类型映射和内存布局
实现运行时支持（如果需要）
添加代码生成测试

steps.name: 添加测试
tasks: 在 unittests/ 对应模块目录中添加单元测试
添加词法分析测试（Lex）
添加语法分析测试（Parse）
添加语义分析测试（Sema）
添加代码生成测试（CodeGen）
添加端到端集成测试
测试边界情况和错误处理

troubleshooting.symptoms: Lexer fails to recognize new keywords or operators
solutions: Verify token is added to Tokens.inc
Check token precedence and associativity
Ensure lexer logic correctly identifies the token
Add lexer unit tests to verify token recognition

troubleshooting.symptoms: Parser fails to parse new syntax
solutions: Check grammar rules are correctly implemented
Verify parser follows correct precedence rules
Add debug output to trace parsing steps
Test with simplified examples first
Check for conflicts with existing grammar
Review type inference rules
Check type compatibility logic
Verify symbol resolution is correct
Add detailed diagnostic messages
Test type checking with various type combinations

troubleshooting.symptoms: AST nodes are malformed or incomplete
solutions: Verify all AST node fields are initialized
Check parent-child relationships are correct
Use AST dump to visualize structure
Ensure memory management is correct
Check CHIR instruction generation logic
Verify operand types match instruction requirements
Use CHIR dump to inspect generated IR
Test with simpler AST structures first

troubleshooting.symptoms: LLVM IR generation fails or produces incorrect code
solutions: Verify LLVM IR is well-formed (use llvm-as to validate)
Check type mappings between CHIR and LLVM types
Use -emit-llvm flag to inspect generated IR
Test generated code with simple examples
Verify runtime support functions are available

troubleshooting.symptoms: Unit tests or integration tests fail
solutions: Run tests individually to isolate failures
Add debug output to failing tests
Verify test expectations match implementation
Check for uninitialized variables or memory issues
Use debugger to step through test execution

troubleshooting.symptoms: Feature works in isolation but fails in combination with other features
solutions: Test interactions with existing language features
Check for namespace or symbol conflicts
Verify feature doesn't break existing functionality
Run full regression test suite
Review code for unintended side effects
